# 🛡️ Security Review

## Change
Files, entry points and commit.

## Data and trust boundaries
What enters the app, what leaves the process and where it is retained.

## Threats
Input injection, unsafe file access, secrets, dependency risks, denial of service and misleading outputs.

## Controls
Validation, bounds, error handling, access restrictions and secret management.

## Privacy
Confirm synthetic-only test fixtures and host review.

## Findings
| Finding | Severity | Owner | Remediation |
|---|---|---|---|

## Decision
Approved / approved with conditions / blocked. Include evidence.
